claims.claim: Williams' Q2 2026 adjusted EBITDA rose 6% year over year to $1.921B and AFFO rose 10% to $1.450B, while management raised the 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance midpoint to $8.4B.
Williams completed the roughly $5.5B Momentum Midstream acquisition on September 3, expanding Haynesville infrastructure positioned for LNG and power demand.

risks.risk: Rapid acquisition and project expansion raise leverage, integration and execution exposure even with fee-based contracted cash flows.

unknowns.unknown: Post-close Momentum integration performance and realized synergies are not yet observable.

claims.claim: Phase one of Williams' Socrates power project was completed on time and within budget, while phase two was targeted for Q4 2026 completion.
A $5.34B capital commitment for a 49% noncontrolling interest in five Power Innovation projects provides external financing validation but also creates a measurable project-delivery obligation.

risks.risk: Power-project economics depend on timely construction, customer demand and gas/power infrastructure execution across a large capital program.

unknowns.unknown: Phase-two Socrates completion and early operating economics remain future checkpoints.
